note: Ports (S3.4, D-114; brief §11, §12). A port definition says what a port's services cost, in credits: `fuel` a unit, `flare` a flare for the rack (F.2; sold where fuel is, optional, free if left out), `hull` a point of hull mended, `system` a bar of system damage mended, and `salvage` what the yard pays for a salvage crate that is nobody's contract. `services` lists what it offers (refuel, repair, sell, hire). Every port on the chart uses the first port here until S3.5 names the ports and gives each its own; markets and faction prices arrive in Stage 7.

items.name: Company dock
items.text: A company dock with a fuel line, a repair gang paid by the hour, a salvage yard that weighs everything twice, and a bar.
